data.body:
Root cause confirmed and fix committed locally (b98e8e0b036, not yet pushed).

Observation: the copied cross-process repro (starve2.py) timed out the writer at 3.02-3.05 s in 3 of 3 runs with all yield probes False. Adding one 0.25 s pause between release and probe let the writer in at 0.54-0.60 s in 3 of 3. The lock is an unqueued polling lock (waiter polls every 37-62 ms in a pass, up to 2.5 s backoff between passes), so a release-probe-retake within microseconds always wins.

Fix: `_give_waiters_a_turn` in `_run_sweep` pauses after each fold for the waiter's poll gap plus 0.5 s (about 0.63 s), or the backoff cap plus 0.5 s (3 s) after a fold of 1 s or more; gap values come from new constants in `lock.py` that the poll loops use. `_sweep_one_ticket` pushes each fold (best-effort). No new lock, env var, or config key.

Tests (`tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_handover.py`, 6): the cross-process writer test and the per-fold publish test fail on old code 3 of 3 (writer `timeout 2.0x`; unpushed counts [1, 2]) and all 6 pass 3 of 3 on the fix. Regression: 22 compaction/lock/concurrency/push modules, 267 passed, 2 skipped. make lint and make typecheck exit 0. make verify running next.

Filed bug breezelike-travelsick-moray (discovered_from) for single folds that hold the lock 100-165 s, which this fix does not shorten.
